authority: Informative ranked synthesis; fixes and gates are proposals, not approved DML decisions.

evidence_legend.local_cli: Executed OpenTofu against synthetic local resources

issues.claim: Import plus a matching-looking declaration universally preserves an immutable artifact and its version-scoped ownership.
evidence: local_cli: local_file rejects import; subsequent create overwrites existing bytes
source: AWS v6.70.0 metadata updates upload an empty body when no content/source exists
source: versioned s3_object destruction enumerates all versions/delete markers of the exact key
issues.possible_fix: Provider-specific adoption admission, preservation plan gate, immutable unique artifact names or narrow version-specific lifecycle adapter.
issues.tradeoff: Reduced provider generality and extra identity/source capture.
issues.policy_question: Whole-object key ownership versus separately managed versions; acceptable import/update operations?
issues.gate: No immutable-artifact adoption claim until an import-capable local provider preserves mismatched existing bytes; AWS behavior requires separate authorization and tests.

issues.claim: Approval or immediate revalidation makes an asynchronous delete safe against newly published roots.
evidence: model: publication between check and delete loses retained object
model: six cooperative fenced interleavings pass, without process/crash durability
issues.possible_fix: Durable victim reservation binding root/membership revisions, enlisted publishers, deletion-in-flight state and non-reopening recovery.
issues.tradeoff: Global coordination; partitions can block publication or disposal.
issues.gate: Killed deleter and two publishers cannot re-root deletion-in-flight identities; no inference from an OpenTofu state lock.

issues.topic: arbitrary HCL composition and executable side effects
issues.claim: Module address namespacing isolates effects and output manifests account for all resources.
evidence: local_cli: local modules overwrite the same path.module file
local_cli: omitting the block skips destroy provisioner; provisioner-created artifact survives
issues.possible_fix: Read-only module bundles, instance workdirs, provider contracts, explicit effect/cleanup registration, isolated deployment runner.
issues.tradeoff: Limits HCL expressiveness and otherwise unconstrained deployment freedom.
issues.policy_question: Which opaque effects are admitted; one root versus isolated stacks for provider-version incompatibility?
issues.gate: Every admitted destructive effect has a durable cleanup obligation; unsupported executable features fail closed.

issues.claim: Exact HCL regeneration reconstructs operational identity/state.
evidence: local_cli: retained state gives no-op; lost state creates new surrogate ID and overwrites file
model: materialized mapping cannot recover vanished state
issues.possible_fix: Preserve state/backend lineage, stable declaration IDs, provider cleanup configuration and import/disposal receipts; verify explicit recovery imports.
issues.tradeoff: Durable operational journal/state backup remains necessary alongside regenerable configuration.
issues.policy_question: Who owns backup and safe state-recovery approval?
issues.gate: Lost-state plan cannot create/replace a retained physical identity without explicit verified recovery.

issues.claim: A resource ID or exported output is sufficient acknowledgement of an execution-ready bound closure.
evidence: local_cli: immediate CLI-import output contains ID with null value; declarative import includes update
model: projecting incidental outputs is a deliberately supplied convention
integration: real output exported into model, not a generalized readiness protocol
issues.possible_fix: Declared adapter-specific binding projection and required-field validation; readiness receipt includes configuration/state revision and successful reconciliation.
issues.tradeoff: Domain-specific validation and more metadata; overbroad identity causes churn.
issues.policy_question: Which endpoint/version/digest/configuration fields affect equality and current executability?
issues.gate: Null/incomplete, drifted or soon-to-be-replaced bindings cannot be published as ready.

issues.claim: Snapshot roots, provenance associations and runtime dependencies are interchangeable retention edges.
evidence: model: ancestor retains compute absent from newest snapshot
model: removing encryption key breaks retained artifact; removing provenance-only compute need not break reuse
model: 512 bounded graph/root cases pass
issues.possible_fix: Full-history census plus typed operational, cleanup, containment and provenance edges; retained-identity plan gate independent of IaC dependency ordering.
issues.tradeoff: Incomplete edges lose artifacts; excessive edges retain expensive infrastructure.
issues.policy_question: Shared-consumer excision authority, cascades and migration acceptance?
issues.gate: Compute retirement retains usable result; required key/storage retirement is blocked or explicitly cascaded.

issues.claim: Recording an attempt or obligation eliminates unknown external effects and leaks.
evidence: model: one attempt hides two reported-only external executions
model: creation before durable identity publication can evade discovery
model: dropping sole cleanup identity strands pending adoption
issues.possible_fix: Durable occurrence allocator, idempotency when available, explicit unknown outcomes, minimal independent cleanup handoff and confirmation receipts.
issues.tradeoff: Unknown/quarantined actions can remain indefinitely; no generic exactly-once guarantee.
issues.gate: Process termination at every effect/acknowledgement/journal boundary retains investigation or cleanup capability.

issues.claim: Sensitive labels, new tombstones or a successful destroy establish physical/global erasure.
evidence: local_cli: sensitive value appears in state and JSON; four plaintext artifacts survive current-state tombstoning
simulation: controlled copies can be cleared while offline copy survives
audit: low-entropy digest recovered in eight actual guesses from a 100-candidate domain
issues.possible_fix: Copy inventory, non-sensitive tombstones, redacted manifests/logs, key/revocation and exceptional same-ID resolution design.
issues.tradeoff: Cannot guarantee uncontrolled replica deletion; immutable-history preservation conflicts with removal of sensitive stored bytes.
issues.policy_question: Erasure authority, permissible residual metadata and assurance scope?
issues.gate: No legal/global erasure claim from these tests; separately test storage pages, backups and replicas.

issues.claim: Exact HCL text and provider lock fully capture an installable closure.
evidence: local_cli: same HCL fails without payload file
documentation: provider lock does not lock remote modules; shared root requires compatible provider versions
issues.possible_fix: Bundle modules/files, pin module revisions, record engine/provider versions and effective non-secret inputs, preserve provider aliases through cleanup.
issues.tradeoff: Capture/retention cost and stack partitioning; complete environmental closure remains an assertion.
issues.gate: Offline replay from captured non-secret bundle validates with unchanged dependency lock.

issues.claim: Content identity counts trials or distinct attempt IDs certify independent observations.
evidence: model: content-identical executions collapse without occurrence IDs; restarted counter can collide
integration: three requests, two actual arithmetic attempts and one result root
model: last-writer status loses knowledge; competing selections require resolution
issues.possible_fix: Collision-safe allocation, ordinary-DAG convention validation, transactional publication and causal observation merge; explicit reuse/independence rationale.
issues.tradeoff: Application conventions and conflict handling beyond pure DAG hashing.
issues.policy_question: Initial/fresh adoption defaults, cross-implementation equivalence and methodology?
issues.gate: No reuse counted as another trial; unknown/conflicting results cannot silently become selected.

issues.topic: reproducible runner path limits and evidence precision
evidence: local_cli: first relocated lab run fails provider Unix socket bind at 124-byte pathname
local_cli: short byte-identical replay passes seven probes and 86 invocations
audit: 100 is candidate-domain size, not measured guesses; version_id line citation corrected to 246–249
issues.possible_fix: Bounded short sandbox names, checksum-pinned reviewed replay inputs, retained failed runs and measured-versus-configured count fields.
issues.tradeoff: Path naming limits and explicit manual archival after eight retained runs.
issues.gate: Failures remain visible; no automatic provider skip, dependency substitution or uncapped retries.
